decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies, utilizing cards like Ocelot Pride, Guide of Souls, and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to quickly establish a strong board presence. The deck also includes various removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to clear the way for attacks. Additionally, cards like The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional power and resilience to the deck's creatures. With support cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures and control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push for disruption, while also featuring powerful creatures like Ocelot Pride and Solitude to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also has a mix of lands to ensure consistent mana base for casting spells efficiently. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the game state to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of powerful creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Hydroelectric Specimen, along with a variety of counter spells and disruption cards to control the game until you can assemble your combo pieces. The key strategy is to use cards like Lotus Bloom and Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive amounts of damage to your opponent quickly and efficiently, while also being able to protect your combo with cards like Pact of Negation and Disrupting Shoal. The deck focuses on winning the game without the need for traditional lands, making it a unique and powerful combo archetype in the Modern format.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game through powerful spells and abilities, utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and The One Ring to manipulate the board state and outmaneuver opponents. With a mixture of removal, counterspells, and card advantage, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions with powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. By leveraging the control elements and powerful threats, the deck aims to dominate the game and secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage. It also utilizes cards like The One Ring and Galvanic Discharge to pump up its creatures and finish the game quickly. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of versatile creatures, burn spells, and disruption, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through countering spells, removal, and card advantage. The deck also includes card draw and graveyard recursion to maintain a steady stream of threats and answers throughout the game.

Overall, the deck aims to control the game through disruption and efficient card advantage, ultimately outlasting the opponent and securing victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of spells and creatures to quickly assemble a powerful combo win condition without relying on traditional land cards. The inclusion of countermagic and card draw spells like Jwari Disruption and Whir of Invention helps to protect the combo and ensure consistent card advantage. The deck's strategy revolves around setting up and executing its combo pieces efficiently to secure a victory.
